overview: SiTok proposes a diffusion autoencoder-based speech tokenizer that jointly learns semantically rich discrete representations via CTC regularization and enables high-fidelity audio reconstruction through flow-matching diffusion, achieving extreme compression at 12.5 Hz token rate and 0.2 kbps bitrate while excelling on understanding, reconstruction, and generation tasks.

modules.name: Mel-Spectrogram Feature Extraction
modules.description: Extracts 50 Hz, 128-bin mel-spectrograms from raw audio waveforms at 24K Hz sampling rate using STFT with configurable hop/window sizes and Hann windowing, followed by global mean-variance normalization using precomputed statistics.

modules.name: Temporal Stacking and Downsampling
modules.description: Stacks every N consecutive mel-spectrogram frames along the feature dimension to reduce the temporal frame rate from 50 Hz down to 12.5 Hz, and provides the inverse unstacking operation for output reconstruction.

modules.name: Causal Llama Encoder
modules.description: Implements a causal Transformer encoder using Llama-style decoder blocks with RoPE positional encoding and SiLU activation, mapping the downsampled mel-spectrogram into a sequence of continuous latent features.

modules.name: Vector Quantization Module
modules.description: Implements a learnable vector quantizer with configurable codebook size and embedding dimension, supporting both single-codebook and multi-codebook (RVQ) configurations with EMA-based codebook updates and commitment loss computation.

modules.name: CTC Semantic Decoder
modules.description: Implements a lightweight causal Transformer decoder that takes quantized latent embeddings as input and predicts textual transcriptions using the Connectionist Temporal Classification loss, providing direct semantic supervision on the discrete latent space.

modules.name: Non-Causal Diffusion Transformer Decoder
modules.description: Implements a non-causal Transformer decoder based on modified Llama blocks with Adaptive RMSNorm for diffusion step conditioning, predicting the velocity field for flow-matching-based mel-spectrogram reconstruction from quantized embeddings.

modules.name: Flow-Matching Diffusion Training Objective
modules.description: Implements the forward diffusion process that interpolates between noise and data samples using a linear schedule, and computes the flow-matching loss between predicted and true velocity fields during training.

modules.name: Combined Loss Function
modules.description: Aggregates the diffusion reconstruction loss, CTC semantic loss with a configurable weight hyperparameter, and VQ commitment loss into a single training objective, balancing acoustic fidelity and semantic consistency.

modules.name: Training Loop with Dynamic Batching
modules.description: Manages the end-to-end training loop with AdamW optimization, learning rate warmup, gradient clipping, and a dynamic batch packing strategy that accumulates utterances up to a target speech duration per GPU to handle variable-length inputs without segmentation.

modules.name: Diffusion Reverse Sampling
modules.description: Implements iterative denoising inference that reverses the diffusion process starting from noise, conditioned on quantized embeddings, with configurable number of sampling steps and optional prompt conditioning for generation tasks.

modules.name: Shortcut Fine-Tuning for Efficient Decoding
modules.description: Implements the shortcut model fine-tuning strategy that trains the decoder to be conditioned on both time step and step size, using a combined flow-matching and self-consistency objective to enable accurate few-step (e.g., 2 or 4 steps) denoising inference.

modules.name: Light-Weight Diffusion Head
modules.description: Partitions the decoder into a main body (run once) and a smaller diffusion head (run iteratively), where the main body produces a base representation and the lightweight head refines it across diffusion steps, reducing per-step computation cost.

modules.name: Token Classifier-Free Guidance
modules.description: Implements training-time random token dropping with a configurable probability to learn unconditional generation, and inference-time guidance that combines conditional and unconditional decoder predictions with a guidance scale to enhance reconstruction fidelity.

modules.name: Decoder Finetuning Strategy
modules.description: Implements a post-training refinement stage where the encoder and VQ modules are frozen and only the decoder is further optimized, specializing it for high-fidelity synthesis from fixed discrete representations.

modules.name: Vocoder Integration
modules.description: Integrates a Vocos-based neural vocoder to convert reconstructed mel-spectrograms back to audio waveforms at 24K Hz, providing the final audio output for subjective and objective evaluation.

modules.name: Reconstruction Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Computes reconstruction quality metrics including Word Error Rate via an external ASR model for intelligibility, speaker cosine similarity via speaker embedding models, and perceptual speech quality scores via UTMOS, evaluated on standard test sets.

modules.name: Understanding Task Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Evaluates learned discrete representations on downstream tasks including emotion recognition, speaker verification, keyword spotting via the DASB benchmark protocol, and automatic speech recognition using both CTC-based and LLM-based decoders.

modules.name: Ablation Study and Scaling Configuration Framework
modules.description: Provides configurable experiment setups for systematic ablation studies covering loss type (diffusion vs. regression), CTC loss weight, codebook size, codebook dimension, codebook number (RVQ depth), frame rate, model size scaling variants, and zero-shot TTS evaluation with an autoregressive language model.
